description: Spans must exceed 1.0 meter to prevent digitizing artifacts.
query:
SELECT 
    id AS span_id,
    name,
    ROUND(ST_Length(geom::geography)::numeric, 2) || 'm is below minimum threshold (1.0m)' AS failure_reason
FROM spans
WHERE ST_Length(geom::geography) < 1.0;

description: No two spans can share identical geometry.
query:
SELECT 
    s1.id AS span_id,
    s1.name,
    'Duplicate geometry with span id ' || s2.id AS failure_reason
FROM spans s1
JOIN spans s2 
  ON s1.id < s2.id 
 AND ST_Equals(s1.geom, s2.geom);

description: Underground equipment must be placed inside a vault polygon.
query:
SELECT 
    e.id AS equip_id,
    'Equipment is not contained within any vault boundary' AS failure_reason
FROM equipment e
LEFT JOIN vaults v 
  ON ST_Intersects(e.geom, v.geom)
WHERE v.id IS NULL;

description: All nodes must have a valid POINT geometry.
query: SELECT id AS node_id, name, 'Invalid geometry type' AS failure_reason FROM nodes WHERE NOT ST_IsValid(geom) OR GeometryType(geom) != 'POINT';

description: All vaults must be valid polygons.
query: SELECT id AS vault_id, name, 'Vault is not a valid polygon' AS failure_reason FROM vaults WHERE NOT ST_IsValid(geom) OR GeometryType(geom) != 'POLYGON';

description: All cables must have a length greater than 0.
query: SELECT id AS cable_id, type, 'Cable has 0 length' AS failure_reason FROM cables WHERE ST_Length(geom::geography) = 0;
